summary: RETENTION IS NOT MEASURABLE HERE AND THE REASON IS STRUCTURAL, NOT A GAP IN THE DATA. The arch is 149.06 deg; 210.94 deg is open air below the chord plane z 9.5000 (the meshslice section at x -38.5 spans z 9.5000..16.1919 and nothing else). An open cradle's holding force is whatever closes it. All four of Pollen's MJCF files were searched (robot_allcollisions.xml and robot_allcollisions_rollers.xml in both reference copies, plus robot_walk.xml): NO geom is placed below this cradle. So retention_N is not a bench number waiting to be taken; it is zero unless an unpublished part closes the arch. What settles it: a photograph or teardown of a real Microduck head with the motor support fitted, or Pollen publishing the head assembly. Two further open items: (1) the axial datum — the MJCF puts the ring at x -40.0000..-37.0000 (2.0000 mm of band contact, 66.7% of the ring width) while the jaw's Ø11.9949 flange would put it at -39.7000..-36.7000; the reference states neither. (2) the 0.2005 mm by which the MJCF's bearing GEOM sits above both parts' axes.

summary: RE-MEASURED the relief between the two ring bands. The 2026-09-02 row recorded it as 'Ø16.8' — one decimal place in a folder whose every other dimension carries four, with no tolerance basis, and it was read by a ray-cast caliper. A ray through a tessellated bore reads the FACET, not the cylinder. Measured instead off the mesh vertices of motor_support.stl: 64 vertices lie in the relief band, in two rings of 32 at x -37.5000 and x -36.5000 with no vertex row between them, at radius 8.40036 mm (sd 0.000124, min 8.40012, max 8.40050) about the cradle axis (y 0, z 7.4995) — Ø16.8007 mm, 1 sigma 0.000247, full spread 0.0008 mm, over an axial length of 1.0000 mm. The tessellation is 32 facets over the 152.4451° that exists (step 4.9176°, sagitta 0.00773 mm), so a ray predicts Ø16.7852; an independent reader's ray at x -37.0 read Ø16.7856, agreeing with that prediction to 0.0004 mm and confirming it is one surface, not two. CROSS-CHECK: the Ø15 ring-band bore measured the same way reads Ø15.0007 (sd 0.000237) — the same +0.0007 mm off ITS nominal, which identifies the offset as the STL's float32 storage rather than a feature. Design nominal Ø16.8000; the relief clears the Ø15.0 bearing OD by 0.9004 mm on radius, so no fit is affected and no other number in this folder changes.
by: claude (microduck lane T, fix pass), out/laneT/remeasure_relief.py on Pollen's motor_support.stl
